verdict.rationale: Temporal documents Schedules that start Workflow Executions at specific times, describes them as more flexible than its Cron Jobs feature, and a community user confirms they work "like a cron but more flexible", so recurring cron-style triggering is clearly supported. Timezone control is only implied by a phase-offset example firing at "5pm UTC"; nothing shows a configurable non-UTC timezone. missing for 10: explicit evidence of per-schedule timezone configuration, documentation of cron-expression syntax on Schedules, hands-on corroboration of timezone behavior.
